kind: continuity divergence record: not a subject binding, not an amendment, not authority

hardening.effect: refuse at commit unless policy is ALLOW, or REQUIRE_HUMAN covered by a human approval held for this exact proposal; bind consequence class, capability and principal into the grant; refuse any authority-relevant proposal change after admission
a Gate holding an evidence register resolves every evidence ref to a contract-valid evidence packet and refuses unknown or stale evidence at evaluation and again at commit

GrantIssuer refuses a child grant of an unknown, revoked, expired or consumed parent, or one exceeding the parent's permitted actions, spending limit, counterparties, legal actor or prohibitions; children inherit prohibitions and never outlive the parent

the Gate deep-copies the proposal at admission and witnesses, claims, executes and records that copy; a change to the caller's object is refused at commit and again inside the ledger lock before the dispatch claim; an uncanonicalisable proposal is refused instead of raising; proposal_id joins the commit-window digest

hardening.port: #12 follow-up: sealed issuer records, lineage, delegation
hardening.effect: GrantIssuer keeps sealed records and hands out copies (get, get_meta) or a published copy it refreshes on revocation, so a holder's edit is an altered grant; every ancestor must be known, unrevoked, unexpired and unconsumed at minting, admission and commit; children together hold at most the parent's limit and the parent spends only what it has not delegated; a child may not raise the consequence class or change the action class or objective; revocation propagates to descendants; costs must be finite and non-negative

evidence_register.statement: The #21 refusal of unknown or stale evidence runs only in a ConsequenceGate constructed with evidence=<register>. No production construction passes one, so on every canonical path (GREG AuthorityOffice, closure registries, egregore sandboxes and missions, foundry kernel_stack) evidence refs are still opaque digests checked for presence only, exactly as on 4b0de6a. The hard rule is unarmed there until a register is wired; this record claims no stale-evidence protection for those paths.
evidence_register.content_addressed_refs: A ref of the form sha256:<64 hex> (the form every in-repo producer emits: adapters/daleobanks_opportunity.py, greg/authority.py command digests, closure probes) resolves to the one register packet whose raw_content_hash it is; none, or several different packets, refuses (policy/engine.py evidence_freshness_reasons). A packet-id ref still must equal the packet's packet_id. Relative to a Gate without a register this still refuses more and authorizes nothing new.
evidence_register.to_arm: Give the canonical Gate a register of contracts/evidence.schema.json packets whose raw_content_hash covers the refs its producers emit (GREG's command digest needs a packet or an explicit typed exemption), then list the construction in armed_at in the same commit; tests/unit/test_consequence_gate.py::test_the_record_lists_every_gate_that_holds_an_evidence_register checks the list against the code.
